finalLens.pull_quote: I can stop after one thing, even when the next small task is already waiting.
finalLens.deeper_read: The task is finished, yet the phone stays close and another little fix comes to mind. When feelings rise fast, action can arrive before the pause does; putting the phone away lets rest remain rest instead of becoming another way to prove you are useful.

finalLens.move: Put the phone in another room after one finished task, and keep the next hour clear.
